It is unclear how they are measured (survey, wait time, handoff duration).","evidence_quote":"- Driver happiness: improve.\n- Faster handoffs: improve.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Use glossary-defined metrics such as driver wait time at pickup, handoff duration, or driver CSAT, with explicit definitions."},{"type":"NO_BASELINE_TARGET","title":"No baseline, numeric target, or timeframe","detail":"Success metrics only say \"improve\" with no current value, numeric goal, or time horizon, so success cannot be evaluated.","evidence_quote":"- Driver happiness: improve.","citations":[],"recommendation":"State the baseline for each metric, a numeric target (e.g., reduce median pickup wait by X minutes), and the timeframe."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Insufficient guardrails for driver-facing change","detail":"Only Cost Per Delivery is listed. A change to driver app pickup behavior would typically need guardrails such as delivery time/lateness, order cancellation or driver offer acceptance rate, and driver earnings/utilization. Also, \"must not increase\" has no threshold.","evidence_quote":"- Cost Per Delivery: must not increase.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add guardrails such as on-time delivery rate, driver offer acceptance rate, food quality/delivery time, and driver earnings per hour, each with tolerance thresholds."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"MDE unit and primary metric unclear; store-cluster design underspecified","detail":"The MDE is \"1 point\" with no metric or unit, and the primary metric is not named, so power cannot be verified. The cluster randomization also lacks detail on cluster count, and drivers working across clusters could be exposed to both arms.","evidence_quote":"Randomized by store cluster. Duration: 3 weeks. MDE: 1 point, power 80%. Primary metric and stopping rule pre-registered.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Name the primary metric, define MDE in its units against a baseline, justify sample size for the cluster design, and show how driver cross-arm contamination is avoided."}]}
